address: The Pinch Hotel, 36 George St., Charleston, SC, 29401, USA
bio: Find Lowland just off busy King Street in a two-story brick former residence across from the boutique Pinch hotel. The first floor is home to a buzzy bar room and casual dining space, while upstairs is a bit more formal. Come for comfort food like a biscuit with farmer cheese and pepper jelly or a tavern burger with fries and a cognac sauce, or entrees like grilled, locally caught grey triggerfish atop a bed of creamy sweet potato polenta with lardons and a bacon vinaigrette. Elevated comfort continues through dessert with house-made hand pies filled with baked apples and caramel plus vanilla-infused whipped cream. ---...
